# VmMaintenance

> PowerShell fleet console (Windows, PS 5.1/7) for server maintenance before in-place OS upgrades, plus a host agent (PS 2.0+) run inside RDP. Environment-agnostic: no hosts, IPs, IDs or credentials in the repository.

Rules an assistant must keep when changing this code:
- One function per file; Public/ = exported, Private/ = internal; noun prefix Vmm.
- ASCII-only source; CRLF for .ps1/.psm1/.psd1/.cs/.sql (PS 5.1 reads BOM-less files as ANSI).
- Never store usernames, passwords or tokens. Credentials live only in $script:VmmCredentials for the session.
- Never put real environment values in the repo; they live in %APPDATA%\VmMaintenance\config.psd1.
- Errors: throw (New-VmmErrorRecord -Activity -Target -Exception -Cause -Fix -ErrorId 'Vmm...').
- OS policy (Get-VmmHostPolicy): target Windows Server 2019; client OS untouched unless ordered; warn management on Server 2008 non-R2 and physical; disk expand after hours only.
- Host changes go through Assert-VmmWindow (Lisbon business hours: checks + staging only).
- Mark security decisions with [SEC] comments; planned extensions with TODO-FUTURE.
- Regenerate FunctionsToExport in VmMaintenance.psd1 when adding a Public file.
